# Persnally

> Local-first personal context engine. Learns who the user is from their existing
> AI history (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, git) and serves that context to every
> AI client over MCP. The data stays on the user's machine — no Persnally cloud,
> every claim traceable to the events behind it, everything deletable.

Install: `npm install -g persnally && persnally setup --yes` (Node >= 22).
Verify: `persnally doctor` — exit 1 means something is broken, and each finding
prints the command that fixes it.

Connects to: claude-code, claude-desktop, cursor, codex, gemini-cli, windsurf,
zed, vscode. ChatGPT's own connectors require a public HTTPS endpoint and cannot
reach a loopback daemon — ChatGPT *history* imports, but live context does not.

## Docs

- [Installing Persnally (for an AI agent)](https://github.com/persnally/persnally/blob/main/docs/AGENT_INSTALL.md): deterministic, non-interactive setup steps, failure modes, and what not to do. Read this first if you are an agent setting Persnally up.
- [README](https://github.com/persnally/persnally/blob/main/README.md): what it is, the five-minute path, the CLI surface.
- [MCP interface](https://github.com/persnally/persnally/blob/main/docs/MCP_INTERFACE.md): the six tools a connected AI gets — get context, ask about the user, search, record signals, list interests, forget.
- [Event schema](https://github.com/persnally/persnally/blob/main/docs/EVENT_SCHEMA.md): the append-only event types and payloads. Versioned open spec (CC-BY).
- [Architecture](https://github.com/persnally/persnally/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): daemon, event store, derived views, provenance.
- [Context depth](https://github.com/persnally/persnally/blob/main/docs/CONTEXT_DEPTH.md): what signals are extracted and why, including corpus-hygiene findings.
